howto.name: Upload a Markdown file
howto.text: Drop a .md file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools renders to HTML, then PDF
howto.text: Standard Markdown syntax: headings, lists, links, images, code blocks, tables, blockquotes. GitHub-flavored extensions supported.

howto.name: Download the styled PDF
howto.text: The output has a clean typographic style with proper headings, monospace code, and clickable links.

faq.a: Local image references in the Markdown are inlined if they're in the same upload; remote URLs are fetched at render time.
Not yet — the default style is GitHub-inspired (clean serif body, monospace code). Custom CSS is on the roadmap.

faq.q: Does it handle code-block syntax highlighting?
faq.a: Yes — fenced code blocks with language hints get tokenized and colored (Python, JS, SQL, Bash, etc.).
